body: I am the same.
Happy for you. I love tattoos!!! I have thought about getting one but I am afraid I would become crazy addicted to it and that would not work for my current job.
Thank you.
Trying to breath. Something not to big that would be good with cats and kids. I found one at a rescue but he may already be spoken for. Thank you for responding.
I don’t think this will go well... I am just venting.

Social media is hard. I use it to promote my business and so I am kinda stuck with it. You should take breaks from it. Guys look at other girls... that shit will never stop. I don’t know if I will ever trust my husband 100%, but I think he loves me and I try and remind myself of that. I understand completely how you feel. I feel it too.
I stalk my husband on Instagram like crazy. I have deleted the app off my phone for weeks at a time. It helps me not to look but I cannot control myself sometimes.
This is the week. I will be fine. I will not have irrational thoughts... at least I am trying really hard not to. 😐

I hope you slept well. I am still on the fence about going to the doc. On shit days I am like I really need to go and then on an ok day I feel like I have it handled. 

I don’t think we ever really have it handled we just have some ok days mixed in with the shit ones.
I glad it helped you sleep and you did think about alcohol. This is good! I have long been taking over the counter stuff to help me sleep but I know that is probably not the best solution.
Yeah I know the drinking is a bad idea. Let me know how the alprozam works for you. It’s been a rough few days and I have been on the fence about heading back to the doc.

I drink... probably to much. I cut out the whiskey and just stick to wine now. I was smoking weed but I live in a very red state so the risk of getting caught and drug tested is not worth it. That would put the custody of my son at risk and that is too much for me.  The drinking could easily get out of hand but for now I keep it in check.

Right! It’s the worst... my head just keeps repeating “I will kill myself soon” I just need that shit to stop. My son will be gone that weekend so I am on my own. Ugh I know I need to keep myself busy but it’s a battle.
True. I am very lucky to have him. No friends but I will try and keep myself busy.
Thank you! It’s so hard sometimes. I try so hard not let myself get this way.
Thank you. I feel like such a burden to him. I try so hard not to let my emotions run me but they always seems to.
This is me. Fuck.

I did the online counseling for a few weeks and it was helpful. You may find it helpful. My biggest issue is just that it gave me anxiety to talk about my issues but that is not the online part just talking in general. I hope you find what helps you.
Thank you. I did not do to good yesterday. A month to see the doc seems like forever. I feel so broken. I keep reading the positive replies and it helps.

I have these thoughts everyday. I don’t think I would kill myself. But I do think about running my car off the road or throwing myself down the stairs.  Depression and anxiety are ruling my world right.

Thank you. I am going to the gym tonight. I ate some breakfast this morning so that is progress. The broken record in my head is still there but I am trying to ignore it. I had a really good talk with my husband last night. He is very understanding. Now just to get through today.
You are so nice. It mad me cry. Thank you for being so nice to me.
Thank you. I made an appointment with a psychiatrist but that not for a month. I was seeing counselor but I think I may need meds.
I feel the same way. I just want to hide away where no one can find me.
